title: N-Heterocyclic carbene (NHC) organocatalysis: from fundamentals to frontiers
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS01179A, Tutorial Review
Sukriyo Chakraborty, Soumen Barik, Akkattu T. Biju
This tutorial review provides an overview of various important structural features and reactivity modes of NHCs and delves deep into the recent advances in NHC-organocatalysis.
